module_summary: Wishbone-to-AXI4 bridge: a skid buffer captures pipelined WB requests, issues single-beat AXI reads or writes, tracks outstanding transactions with a pending counter and direction flag, and returns acks/data (word-selected via an address FIFO) to Wishbone.

anchors.name: i_wb_stb
anchors.why: Wishbone request strobe feeding the input skid buffer.

anchors.name: o_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone ack pulse generated from non-error AXI B/R responses unless flushing.

anchors.name: o_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid, set on accepted WB write, cleared by awready.

anchors.name: o_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid, set on accepted WB read, cleared by arready.

anchors.name: npending
anchors.why: Counts outstanding AXI transactions; drives empty, full and nearfull flags.

anchors.name: m_ready
anchors.why: Accept signal back to skid buffer; deasserted on flush, nearfull, direction change or AXI stalls.

anchors.name: m_valid
anchors.why: Buffered request valid from skid buffer; launches AXI transactions and counter updates.

anchors.name: direction
anchors.why: Records read/write direction of outstanding transactions; blocks direction switch until empty.

anchors.name: flushing
anchors.why: Set on bus error or WB cycle abort; suppresses acks and new requests until empty.

anchors.name: o_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write address registered from buffered WB address.

anchors.name: o_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read address registered from buffered WB address.

anchors.name: o_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data: WB data replicated across the wide bus.

anchors.name: i_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Wide AXI read data, shifted to select the WB word.

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone read data registered from selected return word.

anchors.name: READ_FIFO_DATA_SELECT.addr_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO of sub-word address bits per request, used to select returned word.

anchors.name: o_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid, set with awvalid, cleared by wready.

anchors.name: o_axi_wstrb
anchors.why: AXI write strobes: WB select shifted to the addressed sub-word lane.

anchors.name: i_axi_awready
anchors.why: Clears awvalid and stalls m_ready while awvalid pending.

anchors.name: i_axi_wready
anchors.why: Clears wvalid and gates wdata/wstrb updates.

anchors.name: i_axi_arready
anchors.why: Clears arvalid and stalls m_ready while arvalid pending.

anchors.name: i_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid; decrements pending count and produces WB ack/err.

anchors.name: i_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read response valid; decrements pending count and produces WB ack/err.

anchors.name: o_wb_stall
anchors.why: Wishbone stall: inverse of skid buffer ready.

anchors.name: o_wb_err
anchors.why: Wishbone error from AXI SLVERR/DECERR responses.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: No outstanding transactions; allows direction update and ends flushing.

anchors.name: nearfull
anchors.why: Pending count near capacity; blocks new requests via m_ready.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: Pending counter at capacity; feeds nearfull on decrement.

anchors.name: m_we
anchors.why: Buffered WB write-enable choosing AXI write versus read path.

anchors.name: m_addr
anchors.why: Buffered WB address feeding AXI addresses and address FIFO.

anchors.name: READ_FIFO_DATA_SELECT.wr_addr
anchors.why: Address FIFO write pointer, increments on accepted request.

anchors.name: READ_FIFO_DATA_SELECT.rd_addr
anchors.why: Address FIFO read pointer, increments on AXI response.

anchors.name: READ_FIFO_DATA_SELECT.return_data
anchors.why: Read data shifted by FIFO sub-word offset to select WB word.

groups.name: wb_request_skid
groups.description: Skid buffer capturing Wishbone requests and presenting them to the AXI issue logic.

groups.name: transaction_control
groups.description: Pending counter, direction and flush flags deciding when new requests are accepted.

groups.name: axi_write_issue
groups.description: Registers AXI AW/W channel valid, address, data and strobes.

groups.name: axi_read_issue
groups.description: Registers AXI AR channel valid and address.

groups.name: response_return
groups.description: Converts AXI B/R responses into WB ack/err and selects returned word via address FIFO.
